newsitem.title: UK: Petrak revises Russia July seaborne crude exports.
newsitem.headline: Petrak revises Russia July seaborne crude exports.

text.p: Shipping inspectors Petrak on Monday issued revised figures for Russian seaborne crude exports, showing shipments totalled 1.33 million barrels per day in July, up 235,000 bpd from June.
The revised figures corrected Tuapse figures to show shipments fell narrowly to 91,553 bpd from 101,261 bpd the previous month, rather than a big jump as reported earlier.
Crude exports from the main Black Sea terminal of Novorossiisk ran at 685,570 bpd compared to 803,347 bpd in June but were still ahead of the average so far for the year.
The third Black Sea port of Odessa shipped 259,927 bpd in July, a shade lower than the previous month.
Ventspils on the Baltic moved 293,416 bpd, in line with its average for the year.
